messages:
Nina (docs): Hey team, small docs PR is blocked by a runtime detail. The 'config defaults' page says 'fallback window = 30s' but runtime repo shows 15s. CI preview failing: https://ci.redwood/preview/4001

Omar (runtime): Runtime default for model fallback window was changed to 15s in runtime v2.3 (we forgot to surface this in the docs). The 30s value is outdated.

Nina (docs): Thanks. Is the behavior identical across hosted/dedicated/private? Need accurate wording for the migration note.

Omar (runtime): Yes same across deployment modes. Note: Dedicated customers can override via route config; private installs may have different ops-managed defaults. Suggested line: "By default the runtime uses a 15s fallback window; dedicated and private deployments can override this via route configuration."

Ben (sdk): One more gotcha: our SDK retry helper assumes a 30s window in the examples. I'll update the snippet to read the runtime value dynamically and then show an override example.

Nina (docs): Perfect. Can you paste the short suggested sentence I should add? Also any migration guidance?

Omar (runtime): Wording: "Default model fallback window is 15 seconds (was 30s in older docs). If you relied on the previous timing, check route-level overrides or adjust client retry logic." Migration: non-breaking but could change observed failover timing; recommend auditing clients that tuned fallbacks.

Ben (sdk): I'll open sdk PR and ping @Nina when it's ready.

Nina (docs): I'll update the docs line, add a small callout 'changed from 30s' and a link to the SDK PR when available. Re-running preview after changes. Thanks! :rocket:

ci-bot: Preview build queued (#4001) - awaiting updated commit.
file_notes: Docs PR blocked by stale fallback-window default; runtime confirmed 15s, SDK example update planned; docs to add migration note and link to SDK PR.
